hostNote: The gateway host is issued during builder onboarding; it is not published.
acceptRules: makerAmount comes from quote.maker_amount_e6 and takerAmount from quote.taker_amount_e6, for both directions.
tokenId is the returned Combo YES position ID.
order.builder must equal the returned builder_code.
Sign before quote.expires_at; the acceptance window is not a fixed duration.
outcomeRules: A business failure (no quote, maker decline, execution failure) returns HTTP 200 with status FAILED and a nested error.
HTTP 409 means RFQ state conflict, expired acceptance window, quote mismatch, or a status read before acceptance.
Retrying the same authenticated acceptance does not execute twice; the retry response may omit taker_order_hash.
rfq_id is the stable recovery identifier after a local timeout.
A local timeout is not a failed trade.

quoteFields.total_required_e6: exact requester balance required: collateral including fees for BUY, Combo shares for SELL
quoteFields.net_receive_e6: Combo shares received for BUY; exact collateral proceeds after fees for SELL — use it rather than deriving from blended_price_e6
